title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Bye Honami. I'll see you during our next committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku, wait!
You're going the wrong way!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha... Anyway, I'll see you again during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, see you then!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(That was such a fun party.
I still feel all warm and fuzzy inside...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh no, just thinking about it starting to make me tear up again.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami!
Did you have fun during your party?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I really did!
Thank you so much, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ And I think your apple pie of perfect hospitality's just about ready now♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's right...
We went and had some apple pies together right after I'd met her.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The apple pie was good, and you treated me so nicely too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll repay this apple pie of perfect hospitality one day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're paying me back for that? If anything, I should be giving back to you considering how much you've done for me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, don't say that. I just want you to smile as much as you can♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, you looked so sad sometimes back then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm all smiles now thanks to you and everybody else, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
You get a zillion points for that smile!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, she's here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Here we go☆ Ready...?
Happy birthday, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why are you surprised, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course, I'm surprised. It became so loud all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Um...
Happy birthday, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I really wasn't expecting another surprise like this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Didn't see a second one coming did you? We did get you pretty good this morning.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. And it went perfectly♪

rows.Speaker: Rin & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But time is of the essence, so we should probably get ready for that show, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Since we're doing a birthday show, I'll need to do my best!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I also need to keep doing everything I can if I really do want to become our band's foundation!)
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Mochizuki.
Thank you for coming today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the way, Ms. Mochizuki, did something good happen...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. Today's actually my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What? I'm sorry, I didn't know...
I would've rescheduled if I did.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Work is work, so it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... Wait, I know...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
A birthday present...
But... I don't have anything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Please, it's okay. Don't mind me.
Oh, I will need to borrow a vase again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I brought some Nerines today.
Also known as spider lilies.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
These are lilies...?
I guess there are some similarities...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
I can give you some flowers as a present next time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you really don't have to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know much about flowers so I'm not sure if I'll be able to pick out something that's appropriate, but I'd like to show my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's willing to say this much, so we must've grown much closer since we first met.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe. In that case, I think I'll take her up on her offer.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Yoisaki.
I can't wait to see what you pick out!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: “I've decided to get Ms. Mochizuki these flowers called chocolate cosmos, and they apparently smell like chocolate. Would you mind giving them a sniff?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Happy birthday, Honami!
Unfortunately, I won't be there to celebrate with you today, but you're always welcome at our home!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Truth be told, I've been working with Saki on a birthday song for you and I believe we're ready now! We'll eagerly be awaiting your arrival!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Your smile was sooo wonderhoy just now Honami♪ I hope that smile of yours never ever goes away☆”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Thank you for teaching me how to swim while we were at the Seaside School. It became a nice surprise for my parents when we went on a trip later that summer.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Honami, thank you for always taking such good care of Shii. It's incredible how you're both in a band now, but don't push yourself too hard, okay...?”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Honami, I'd like to celebrate with some apple pies but I want to make it the way you like, so would you mind coming over to my house and giving me some advice on how to make them?”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I'm so glad that she liked our surprise party♪ But until the clock strikes midnight, it's her birthday, so the four of us should keep celebrating tonight!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “You seem so much more confident in your drumming now. Your performances in SEKAI sound great too, so you'll be the foundation of Leo/need in no time.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I never expected everyone to celebrate like this. Oh no, just thinking about it is making me tear up again...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everybody in my class is so nice too. I'm almost wondering if I even deserve to be this happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I want to do everything possible for those I can help and make this year really count!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I'd really appreciate it if you could continue watching over me and giving me your support.
